name: Boone Bennett
source:
Known as a hard worker and a cowboy with a heart of gold, you always considered Boone to be the better half of your duo. With a quick wit and a contagious sense of humor, Boone keeps the spirit high even in the toughest situations.

You always said you could never wish for a better best friend.
